decisions.reason: The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already incorporates the statement that active prize tickets transfer with a sold NFT; no additional FAQ state change is required.
Ticket transfer upon an NFT sale does not change the requirement governing fiat-user dashboard access or wallet requirements for receiving and holding rewards.
The transfer of active tickets changes NFT transfer-state semantics but does not alter Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility windows, reset behavior, weighting, funding, or draw parameters.
Transferring active tickets does not change the one-click prize claim method, Winners page announcement channel, or claim-page URL.
Active-ticket ownership after an NFT transfer does not change primary-sale founder, commission, prize-pool, or fiat-fee allocations.
The source change concerns active prize tickets, not the mint-number source, permanence, or display locations of the NFT-owned referral code.
Ticket transfer on secondary sale does not change commission allocation for a mint completed without a referral code.
The active-ticket transfer rule has no effect on the current project name or conditional future platform branding.
The transfer of active tickets changes NFT transfer-state semantics but does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility windows, reset behavior, funding, or draw parameters.
Although the source concerns an NFT sale, it does not change the secondary royalty amount, founder allocation, prize-pool funding, or rule that secondary sales do not generate referral tickets.
Ticket ownership after NFT transfer does not change the Transak provider, supported fiat methods, conversion asset, or preexisting wallet and crypto requirements for fiat minting.
The active-ticket transfer rule is unrelated to blocking access to the landing page from Mauritius.
